discovery: Development of next-generation (massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis) DNA sequencing technology
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes went to MOFs (2025), protein design and structure prediction (2024) and quantum dots (2023), so the committee may return to chemical biology and analytical methods. Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis rests on reversible-terminator nucleotide chemistry and clonal cluster amplification on surfaces. It has transformed genomics and medicine and has been widely recognized already, including the 2022 Breakthrough Prize. That makes it a mature, high-impact candidate with a clear chemical core.
